bio: The view of the Drierivierenpunt and the endless stream of boats always draws plenty of attention in this sleek yet cosy bistro. A glance at the tempting set menu reveals that the chef likes to elevate French cuisine with North African spices. From tender lamb neck served with a robust meat-based jus, to crisp pistachio-filled baklava accompanied by mint and yogurt ice cream – this cuisine is defined by precise technique, bold flavours and meticulous plating. The 250-label wine list, with a particular emphasis on Burgundy and broad international reach, is sure to pique your interest....
